iron_staff.name: Iron Staff
iron_staff.description: A six-foot iron staff, favored by monks and wandering fighters for its defensive versatility.

dragon_head_staff.name: Dragon-Head Staff
dragon_head_staff.description: A heavy wooden staff topped with a carved iron dragon head. Channels Qi through its hollow core.

celestial_bamboo_staff.name: Celestial Bamboo Staff
celestial_bamboo_staff.description: Carved from mountain bamboo rumoured to have absorbed decades of ambient Qi. Impossibly light yet immovable when Qi is channelled through it.
